shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 2 on the number line on the left with the mark at x=10 where the arch reaches the horizontal axis on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed interval excludes its boundary value 2. Right image: The displayed function has no value at x=10.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow dot makes equality at 2 inadmissible for the interval. On the right, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=10.
